notes: Two features and seven fixes. The typography tokens were restyling the Etch builder's own interface, because the builder shell is a front-end request and the token rule names bare elements; the builder and the block editor now get the font declarations without the rules that paint a page. The Google weights row deleted a weight when you unticked one, under a button that said Download. Variable axis sliders were shown for static installs. Apply to now refuses any selector a typography token covers, whichever family holds it, and its warnings update as you type. The panel no longer sits beneath overlays painted by other plugins. Added: the WOFF2 decoder, so a variable font uploaded already compressed gets its axes read; reading axes from files already on the server; and an optional metric-matched fallback so text does not shift when a font arrives.
